name: week
title: Rate planning week
subtitle: Internal proposal review; no prices sent

sections.title: Proposed nightly totals and blockers
sections.sql: select code || ' / ' || name as room_type,stay_date,occupancy_pct,proposed_cents,total_cents,currency,readiness from rate_plan where stay_date between current_date and current_date+14 order by code,stay_date,name

sections.title: Source comparison
sections.sql: select code || ' / ' || name as room_type,stay_date,vendor_cents,current_cents,proposed_cents,currency,min_stay from rate_plan where stay_date between current_date and current_date+14 order by code,stay_date,name

sections.title: Review blockers and overdue work
sections.sql: select code,name,due_on,issue from attention order by due_on,code,name

sections.title: Latest snapshot against previous observation
sections.sql: select code,name,stay_date,observed_on,sold,pickup_rooms,adr_cents,revpar_cents,currency from pickup order by code,stay_date,name
sections.note: Net change between the two latest snapshots, not gross new bookings. ADR and RevPAR use recorded room revenue on the same basis as your occupancy source.
